title: Oil retraces amid a stalemate in US-Iran talks
section_path: Oil retraces amid a stalemate in US-Iran talks
section_path_text: Oil retraces amid a stalemate in US-Iran talks
summary:
Main
Energy fell as oil supplies find their way out of the Persian Gulf. Precious metals fell on profit taking. Industrial metals edged higher on supply concerns.

children.title: Main
children.summary: Energy fell as oil supplies find their way out of the Persian Gulf. Precious metals fell on profit taking.

children.title: Market Commentary
children.summary: Crude oil prices fell as traders weighed up the limited progress of talks on reopening the Strait of Hormuz with signs of oil flows rising. Earlier this week US Energy Secretary, Chris Wright, said flows have averaged 9mb/d over the past week, well above what ship tracking data suggest.

children.title: Chart of the Day
children.summary: China could once again step in to help tightness in the oil market. China banned fuel exports in early March, in order to safeguard the domestic market from the loss of Persian Gulf oil.
